1. (Currently Amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, __and wherein the membrane (10) has a resonant frequency below 200 Hz__.

2. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone __and the membrane (10) is formed by injection molding of the silicone elastomer__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

5. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 __or 4__, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), __and wherein the stiffening element (16) has a Young's modulus greater than 100MPa__.

6. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 __or 4__, further comprising a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 1cm3 __and the speaker operates at frequencies below 200 Hz__.

7. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 6, wherein the back volume (36) is less than 0.5cm3 __and the support structure (32,34) is configured for use in a handheld communication device__.

8. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 __or 4__, wherein the resonant frequency is below 300 Hz __and the elastomer has a thickness between 0.1mm and 0.25mm__.

9. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 __or 4__, wherein the resonant frequency is below 250 Hz __and the Young's modulus is below 50MPa__.

10. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa __and a resonant frequency below 200 Hz__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

11. (Currently Amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone __and the forming step comprises injection molding of the silicone elastomer__.

12. (Previously presented) A method as claimed in claim 10 or 11, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Currently Amended) A method as claimed in claim 10 __or 12__, wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8), __wherein the stiffening element (16) has a Young's modulus greater than 100MPa__.
